Hi all —

We have three teams that asked for a hands-on sandbox walkthrough this week (Nguyen AI, BrightCart, CloudForge). Instead of three separate evenings, Jordan and Laura and I can run a single "sandbox batch" session with short timebox lanes for each prospect (20–25 min each + 10 min Q&A).

Quick ask: please pick whichever of these evening slots works for you (we'll finalize once all replies are in):
- Tue 5/11: 5:30–7:00pm PT (lane order TBD)
- Wed 5/12: 6:00–7:30pm PT
- Thu 5/13: 5:45–7:15pm PT

Poll link: https://tinyurl.com/ri-sandbox-poll-2027 (one-click selection).

Attached: redwood-sandbox-runbook.pdf (short runbook + what to bring). We can also split the agenda to prioritize the integrations each team cares about — if you have a preferred focus (e.g., embeddings tuning, throughput testing, private deployment config), reply with one line.

If any team needs a dedicated full-hour session instead of a lane, flag that and we'll carve out a follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to consolidating and saving everyone's calendar pain.

— Avery
